notablePrerequisites: At least one of those sources should be a basic land.
description:
Pay {4} to activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first activated ability, creating two 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Use Earthcraft's activated ability on an Eldrazi spawn token, tapping it and untapping a basic land you control.
Float the mana from that basic land and untap it again with the other Eldrazi spawn token.
With {2} floating, sacrifice both of the Eldrazi spawn to make {2} more.
Use the {4} you just made to again use Spawnsire of Ulamog's ability and repeat the loop.
